tei:div.tei:p: 603) ༄༅/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mdor bsdus kun mkhyen zhal lung bzhugs// 604)༄༅/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mdor bsdus kun mkhyen zhal lung ni/ chos sku'i ston pa kun mkhyen klong chen pa// longs sku'i ston pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling*// sprul sku'i ston pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang*// sku gsum ston pa kun mkhyen gsum la 'dud// gang gi thugs mdzod ma dros rgya mtsho las// rang skal dza hṇu'i rgyun bzang drangs pa las// yang zhun zegs ma tsam zhig 'dir 'thor na/ 605)/yab sras gsum gyis bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ de yang rtsol bcas theg pa brgyad las 'das pa rtsol med 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen por sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum las/ phyi mar rgyud bcu bdun/ klong gsal 'bar ma/ sngags srung khros ma bcas la brten pa'i snying thig ma gnyis/ yang tig gsum/ mdzod chen bdun/ ngal gso gsum dang bcas pa'i don rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying 606)gi thig le'i/ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po sems can rnams kyi sems kyi babs/ gshis yin lugs 'dug tshul chos nyid ngo bo ye dag rang bzhin rnam dag gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas su gnas kyang*/ gshis la ma zhugs pa'i glo bur dri ma 'bral rung gis sgrib pa de lam gyis spangs nas yin lugs ji lta ba mngon du gyur ba 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po ste/ gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin byed lam rdzogs pa chen po la/ smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin/ mi dge bcu 'khor bcas spangs pa'i dam tshig dag pas nyams su len bya khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis las/ dang po la sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu rdib pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprad pa/ rjes nyams kyi skyob tshul dang gsum las/ dang po gnyis go bde bar bshad na bzhi las/ sems rtsad bcad pa ni/ chags sdang rmongs pa dang mi dge bcus 'khor ba ngan song sgrub pa/ yang dag 607)pa'i lta ba dang bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum gyis lha mi'i go 'phang*/

nges 'byung dang bslab pa gsum gyis nyan rang*/ byang chub sems dang phyin drug gis sangs rgyas/ bskyed rim gyis thun mong*/ rdzogs rim gyis mchog dngos sgrub kyang sems gtso bo lus ngag grogs yin par rigs pas grub bo/ lung ni/ yid gtso yid ni rab tu mgyogs pa ste// dge ba dag ni sogs dang*/ khyod kyi thugs dul sogs so/ gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ lus ngag yid gsum 'di gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na lus ngag mthong thos bzhin sems der thal/ sems mthong thos med pa bzhin lus ngag der thal bas/ bdag tu bzung ba'i gzhi gcig tu ma grub/ bdag gir 'dzin pa bzhin tha dad na rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang ba dang*/ mi rtag du ma zhan dbang can gang yin brtags na 'dus byas tshogs pa ltos pa 608)can yin pas snga ma ma grub/ phyi ma yang lus ngag bems po rags pa/ rdul phran/ de cha med/ de rang bzhin med pas stong nyid/ de la rten 'byung snang*/ de gnyis dbye gsal med do/ sems shes pa skad cig ma/ 'das pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da lta skad cig ma'ang ma grub pas stong*/ gsum pa thun mong 'byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa ni/ byung ba'i yul phyi yul drug nang dbang po drug bar snang mun rdul bcas ma grub/ byung mkhan blo gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar ma grub/ gnas 'gro yang de bzhin no/ bzhi pa yul can sems kyi gshis la brtags nas gnas lugs 'od gsal chen po bstan pa gnyis las dang po ni/ lus chos bdun lhod chags/ dbang po yan par/ sems mi spro mi bsdu rang babs yal du bcug pas/ go mkhan 609)tshor mkhan gyi shes pa ( g.yi li ma ? ) sbi li ma zhig rnyed dgos pas dpyad pas mi 'ong bzhag dgos/ de yang sa ra has/ ma yengs sems kyis rang gi rang la ltos/ zhes pa bzhin kha nang du log tsam gyi mtshams de shes nas/ yul med kyi rig pa rjen sang tshogs brgyad dang ma 'dres pa/ rig cha yod la 'gyu cha med pa zhig yod tshe/

de dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rtog bcas dang rtog med thams cad yin min brtags tshe min thag chod na rmugs cha kun gzhi/ gnas cha kun gzhi'i rnam shes sogs rtog pa phra rags thams cad min pa zhig yod tshe/ de gzhan gyi rig thabs med de/ thug med du 'gyur/ rang gi rig na bya byed 'gal bas ji ltar rig tshul thag chod pa byung na/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sogs bzhin no/ sems sngar med gsar du skye/ so so tha dad 610)'dzin pa dang dbye/ de gnyis gcig med na gcig shos yod lo min dpyad pa sogs so/ de dag gis shan 'byed do/ la bzla ba ni ngo bo dang sems gnyis/ me dang tsha ba/ chu dang brlan/ nyi ma dang zer bzhin rtsal rol pa 'char tshul che ba'i rgyan du shes pas/ ngo bo'i steng na dge sdig phan gnod dang 'bral ba/ des shes rab kyis lta ba dag rtsal gyi steng na rgyu 'bras bslu med du grub pa des thabs kyi spyod pa dag sems kyi sgom pa gzung dran 'gyu dran/ ngo bo'i sgom pa gnyug ma'i dran pa rang babs kyi bsam gtan no/ spyod pa gang khas blangs ba'i sdom pa dam tshig thams cad nyes skyon bral ba mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa 'di las dang por gces so/ gnas skabs lam gyi 'bras bu'i rtags sgo gsum la shar te byang chos so bdun snying rje dang shes rab gnyis kyis bsdus te yod yong*/ med na sgom min/ tshad rmi lam gyis bzung*/ 'bras bu sgom shugs kyis skye 'chi bar do gsum la grol lo/ 611)gnyis pa de ltar gtan la dbab pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa la/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ thugs rje zung 'jug de rig pa chos skur ngo sprod/ rtsal gyi snang ba thams cad chos sku'i rol par ngo sprad pa ni ngo rang thog tu sprad/ lam gyi chos thams cad de la 'dus par bstan pas thag gcig thog tu bcad/ lus mi g.yo ba chos bdun ri rgyal lta bu dbang po mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho'i gza' skar lta bu/

rig pa mi g.yo ba sprin bral nam mkha' lta bus sgom gdeng grol thog tu bca' ba la/ nor bu 'dam gyis ma gos pa bzhin rig pa ye grol/ sbrul mdud nam mkhar grol ba bzhin rnam rtog rang grol/ mkha' la klog bzhin skyes tshad shar grol yin yang*/ cer grol la/ dang po rnam rtog ngo shes dgos 612)'og 'gyu ther la bud pa'i phyir/ bar du rtsal rdzogs dgos/ rkyen ngan lam du slong ba'i phyir/ tha ma thog bab chen po'i lta stangs kyis rang grol btang dgos/ 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud las grol ba'i phyir ro/ gsum pa rjes nyams kyis skyong tshul la/ sngon gyi las dang da lta'i rtsa rlung 'du 'phrod las/ lus la rdzu 'phrul nad dang gdon/ ngag la snyan tshig dang dig lkugs/ sems kyi snang nyams lhar mthong dang 'drer mthong*/ shes nyams bde gsal mi rtog dang chags sdang rmongs gsum rnams nyams/ ngo bo rtog pa yin par shan dbye/ chu dang rlabs bzhin du thag bcad/ lus kyi bca' bshig ngag smra bcad dang phaṭa sgra brjod/ mig lta stangs rje/ sems kyis sgom blo bor ba rnams so/ de shrī sengha'i khyung chen gshog rdzogs ky-i dgongs pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa thod rgal la skye 'chi 613)bar do gsum du grol tshul las/ dang po la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la sku gsum gyi sna khrid pa 'byung bzhi'i rnal 'byor la bslab tshul gzhan du shes/ rig pa'i sna khrid pa 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba la phyi ltar du rigs drug gi sdug bsngal blo la blangs nas lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig dril/ de bzhin dran tshad dgag sgrub med par gtad med du btang*/ chos kyi spyod pas mtha' bsdu/ nang ltar du rigs drug sa bon 'bru gsum gyis bsreg sems las rung byed pa sgo gsum sngon 'gro la/ lus rdo rje rtse 'dug ngag gi phyi snang ba rgyas 'debs/ snang ba thams cad hūm̐ du bsgom/ nang phung po rgyas 'debs/ lus nang hūm̐ gis bkang*/

snang ba rtsal sbyang*/ snang ba hūm̐ gis bshig phung po rtsal sbyangs/ lus hūm̐ gis phug gnyen btsal/ hūm̐ gis 614)skud pas dkri/ lam gzhug hūm̐ du gyur pa dang 'khor ba dang 'das pa zhing lngar bsgrod/ sems 'byung gnas 'gro gsum snga ma bzhin sbyang ba rnal du dbab pa gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag sor gzhug pa la/ nyan thos lta stangs kyis rnam rtog zhi/ byang sems lta stangs kyis zhen pa spong*/ khro bo'i lta stangs kyis rig thog grol/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lta ba ri bo cog bzhag ngo sprod/ bsgom pa rgya mtsho cog bzhag 'dzin pa med par bskyang*/ spyod pa man ngag cog bzhag rig ngo rjen par bskyang*/ 'bras bu ma bcos cog bzhag rlung lnga dbyings su 'chings pa'i rtags rang shugs su 'char ba'i khregs chod la gzhi bzung ste/ thod rgal dngos la/ lus ngag yid kyi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang*/ sgo gsum gyi gnad ston pa la/ lus/ seng glang drang srong bzhugs stangs gsum/ ngag 615)smra ba bcad pas rlung dal/ sems gnad mkha' la gtad/ gnad gsum gyis 'od gsal la blta ba la 'char byed sgo yi gnad 'byung spyan la brten pa'i sgron ma'i spyan 'od rtsa mig la zug pa rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma/ zlog phab zur gyis blta ba dang*/ phyed btsum zim bus nyi ma la khru gang ma reg par blta/ 'char gzhi yul gyi gnad nam mkha' rkyen dang bral ba/ rlung gnad rlung kha nas 'phang ste phyir 'dzin/ rig pa'i gnad phyi dbyings sngon po dang*/ 'od lnga'i gdangs can dang*/ nang dbyings nang gi 'od rtsa'i sbubs stong*/ phyi dbyings rnam dag sgron mar/ thig le stong sgron 'od lnga'i mu khyud can 'char ba/ yul dmigs pa dag pas yul can nang gi rig pa shin tu dwangs la/ yul med pa ni shes rab rang byung sgron ma/ de nas rig cha dwangs pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud mu tig bstar la brgyus pa'am/ gser skud ldeng ba ltar snang ba'o/ de nas nyams len srod du 'dzud pa la spro ba can gyis tho rangs dang por bla ma'i rnal 'byor/

616)bar par khregs chod/ tha mar gtum mo/ nam langs nas nyi shar bar kha btaun/ de nas gung gi bar thod rgal/ gung la chos spyod/ phyi dro thod rgal/ dgong mor gtor ma rlung 'dzin/ srod thun dang por mi rtag bar par bskyed rim/ gung thun gnyid 'od gsal du sba/ kun la dam pa gsum gyi zin dgos/ spros pa med pas/ nyin mo thod rgal nyag gcig mtshan mo/ srod la gtum mo/ gung la a nyer gcig dmigs pas gnyid 'od gsal du sba/ tho rangs ha zhes dbugs btang la/ a la sems bzung*/ spyod pas bogs 'don pa'ang thos bsam tshol/ dben pa brten/ smra ba bcad/ the tshom bcad/ gcig tu mi gnas/ dur khrod tu rgyu/ gtsang dme spang ba rnams rim par bya/ snang bzhi'i sa mtshams kyang*/ nyi zla mar me la rim par 617) gom pas thig le sum sbrel snang ba tshun chos nyid mngon sum/ sku shar ba tshun nyams gong 'phel/ snang ba'i 'phel cha rdzogs/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ lus sems tshad la phebs pa rig pa tshad phebs/ phyi snang ba'i yul zad/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems zad/ gsang ba nyams snang gi 'phel zad pa ni chos nyid zad pa ste/ de'i dus na skye ba la dbang thob pas 'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs/ ( 'jug ? )la dbang thob pas nang dbyings su sangs rgyas/ mtha' brten gyi man ngag la/ mi 'gul ba gsum la gzhi bca' ba ni/ lus bzhugs stangs/ ( rtsal rlung rang dal/ ?) mig gzigs stangs/ snang ba'i 'phel 'dzin/ sems gzo med dbyings rig zung ( 'jug ?) sdod pa gsum gyi tshad bzung ba ni/ lus bya ba mi gnas 618)'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog zad/ rlung 'phel med rnam rtog g.yo ba'i rkyen zad/ snang ba 'dar 'khrigs med/ zhing khams tshad la phebs/ 'di yi tshe rtags sgo gsum la 'char te/ chos nyid mngon sum dus/ lus g.yo med/ sems gar gtad sdod/ gong 'phel dus/ lus sgeg chos bral/ ngag byung rgyal smra/ sems 'khor bar mi 'jug tshad phebs dus/ lus 'byung bas mi thogs/

ngag gzhan la phan/ sems 'khor bar mi 'jug par thag chod/ chos zad dus/ lus bag tsha bral/ ngag rjes su zlo/ sems na bun ltar yal/ tshad rmi lam gyis bzung ba ni/ rab 'od gsal du dag 'bring rmi lam du shes/ tha mal bzang po sha stag rmi/ thob pa gsum gyi gzer ni/ phyi snang ba rkyen snang zhing khams 'char/ nang sgyu lus gdos 619)bcas 'od gsal du dag gsang ba rlung sems sdig can gyi rnam shes la rig pa gtad pas drong*/ gdeng bzhi ni/ ngan song la bag mi tsha/ rgyu 'bras rnam smin la mi re/ thob bya la re ba med/ dga' brod mnyam nyid du dag pas/ tshe 'dir lhag ma med par yang dag par sangs rgyas pa dang*/ lhag bcas bar dor mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas 'grub bo/ des rab tshe 'dir grol tshul lo/ gnyis pa/ 'bring bar dor grol tshul ni/ rang bzhin gyi bar dor thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ 'chi kha'i bar dor 'od gsal sbubs 'jug 'pho ba nam mkha' sum phrug gam/ yul dang gnas la 'jug pa'i 'pho ba/ 'pho lung nyid do/ chos nyid bar dor rnam shes nam mkha' la thim dus/ khregs chod kyis grol/ ma grol na nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim/ 620)snang ba thams cad 'od du 'tsher/ 'di man thod rgal la goms pas grol dgos pas/ skad cig dang por rang snang rang bzhin med par yid ches/ gnyis pa rang sa ru grol/ gsum pa grol thog btsan sa zin pas/ de phan snang ba gang yang med/ de nas 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim/ zhi khro'i snang ba 'char/ sku'i zer thag la brten nas rig pa 'od la 'jug snying ga'i zer thag gis 'od rig par 'jug go de la brtan pa ma thob na/ zung 'jug ye shes la thim/ sngo dkar ser dmar gyi snam bu thig les brgyan pa/ steng du 'od zlum dang bcas pa 'char/ de nas ye shes lhun grub la thim/ sngar gyi snang ba de dag dang rig pa steng gi 'od zlum la 'dus pa'i rkyen las/ steng du 'od zlum dang bcas pa 'char/ de nas ye shes lhun grub la thim/

sngar gyi snang ba de dag dang rig pa steng gi 'od zlum la 'dus pa'i rkyen las/ steng na ka dag gi snang ba/ bar na longs sku zhi khro'i snang ba/ phyogs mtshams 621)'gro 'dul sprul pa'i snang ba ste dag pa myang 'das kyi sgo dang*/ 'og nas 'gro drug gi snang ba ste ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo/ 'od ltar shar ba dang*/ sku ltar shar ba gnyis yul/ ye shes dang thugs rje gnyis yul can/ gnyis med dang mtha' grol gnyis yul can gyis yul la bya ba byed pa'i tshul ltar shar ba las sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar/ rang snang la the tshom mi za bar yid ches/ mi 'gyur ba gser gyi thur ma'i dpes yid ches thog las gzhan du mi yo par btsan sa bzung*/ dpag chen gyi mda' tshur la mi ldog pa'i dpes btsan sa bzung ba'i gshis la mi g.yo bar bzhag pas grol/ 'di'i skabs na rjes su dran pa drug kyang 'byung ste/ lha dang*/ lam/ skye gnas dang*/ bsam gtan/ bla ma'i man 622)ngag lta ba rnams/ mngon par shes pa drug kyang 'byung ste/ sngon gyi skye gnas/ 'chi 'pho skye ba/ gzhan gyi sems/ snang ba lkog gyur/ rigs drug gi gnas/ dbang po rnam par dag pa'i mngon shes so/ sngon thos dang ma thos pa'i chos rnams rgyud la/ 'char te de dag tu grol ba'i gnad/ rig stong zang thal rjen pa rang thog dang po shes te/ yin thog tu thag chad/ grol thog tu gding bca' dgos/ rang bzhin snang ba la phar bltas na mtha' yas kyang*/ tshur bltas na gcig kyang med pas/ med do snyam pa'i 'dzin pa'ang rang grol ba'i skad cig ma'i rjen pa'i rang ngor rtog dpyod med pa ni gdod ma'i grol sar spar gyis btab pa'i gnad/ thugs rje yul la ji ltar 'jug kyang de nyid kyi rjes mi bcad/ nang du mi dgag shar ba de kar cog gis 623)bzhag pas/ phyi nang bar med kyi shes pa zang thal le bas/ bar do'i snang ba rig gdangs su rang dag nas grol ba gcer mthong ngo shes pa'i gnad de srid pa bar do/

sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can sogs bzhin 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ ya nga'i g.yang sa gsum/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug can te/ 'gro drug gi skye gnas kyang*/ lha mir 'od dkar po mgo gyen/ lha min kha char/ dud 'gro khrag mtsho/ mgo phred/ yi dwags du ba/ dmyal ba sdong dum mam bal nag gsed pa lta bu/ mgo thur/ de dag gi tshe na rab lta bas bden med/ 'bring dbang don nyams len/ tha mas mi sdug 'du shes sogs kyis mngal sgo khegs so/ gsum pa dbang po tha ma rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du dbugs 'byin pa ni/ 624) rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams lnga la 'dun pa gtad pas/ der skyes te lo lnga brgya nas grol lo/ kun mkhyen rnam gsum man ngag nyi zla bzhin// ches cher 'bar bzhin de la 'jug dgos kyi// me khyer snang 'dis dgos pa med mod kyang*// sems dges nyes pa med snyam rtsa tshig tsam// bris pa'i dge ( dpe sde mig ? )'di yis kyang*// kun mkhyen yab sras dgongs don ji lta ba// rtogs te khyad chos drug ldan gdod ma'i dbyings// 'gro kun phyam gcig grol ba'i bkra shis shog zhes 'phags pa'i ye shes mngon sum du mthong ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa bsod nams dbang grags dang mgon bla 'jam dbyangs bzang po'i ngor dā ri dra padma ma ṇis gang dran bris pa dge legs 'phel//

625)༄༅/ khregs chod khrid gzhan la gnang ba'i phyag tho bzhugs so// 626)༄༅/ khregs chod khrid gzhan la gnang ba'i phyag tho ni/ lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal/ sems gnad zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa/ 'bras bu la dmigs pa smon sems ( dam pa 'jug sems ldan pa ? )theg chen spyi'i sems bskyed/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams chad ye nas sangs rgyas yin kyang yin go ma chod pas rang gnas su bsgral bar bgyi'o snyam pa sngags kyi sems ye shes su bskyed pa/ bla ma spyi bor 627)sgom ste gsol gdab 'od zhu bya ba/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mthar rjes mthun pa'i bsngo ba bcas spyi la gal che/ dngos gzhi sgom don theg rim dgu'i yang rtse 'od gsal rdzogs chen la/ sems klong man ngag gsum las man ngag rgyud bcu bdun/ mdzod bdun/ ya bzhi klong snying rnams kyi dgongs don ltar la/ gzhi ni/ sems kyi chos nyid ye sangs rgyas pa glo bur sgrib pa can 628)de 'bras bu yin lugs mngon gyur lam la smin dbang ya bzhi/ dam tshig mi dge bcu srog la bab ( pa'i ? )kyang rtsa 'dzem/ grol byed la thod rgal dang khregs chod gnyis la phyi nang dang*/ rgyu 'bras yid ches/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum gyi mtho ris thob pa dang*/ nges 'byung gis bslab pa gsum gyis gnad thob pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyis pha rol phyin drug la/ sangs rgyas thob pa/ sngags kyis bskyed rim gyis thun mong*/ rdzogs rim gyis mchog dngos sgrub pa sogs mdor na 'khor 'das kyi bya ba gang bsgrub kyang lus ngag yid gsum las gang gtso che dpyad dgos/ sems gtso che ba lung rigs gnyis kas grub pa de yin/ lus ngag yid gsum 'di gcig red dang*/ tha dad red/ tha dad yin na nga zer nas 'dzin don ci red/ gcig yin na/ lus ngag mthong thos lo ba bzhin/ sems 629)mthong thos lo dgos ( min ? )dpyod/

sems can rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu bzung*/ de la nga zhes zhen/ de ma gtogs par gzhan ces bzung*/ gzhan yid 'ong la chags/ mi 'ong ba la sdang*/ chags sdang las ngan bsags/ 'khor ba mtha' med 'khyams pa yin/ da dpyad na nga zhes 'dzin nyes tsam las/ nga bdag ( gi )gzhi lus ngag yid gsum gcig ma yin tha dad yin/ lus mthong rgyu yod/ sems mthong rgyu med/ ngag thos rgyu yod/ sems thos rgyu med/ lus ngag yid gsum so so tha dad pa yin/ da lus ngag yid gsum so so nas rtag pa red dang mi rtag pa red/ lus lhu gcig red dang ma red/ rang dbang can red dang gzhan dbang red dpyod shog lus ngag yid gsum mi rtag pa red rtag pa/ 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa lo dang zla ba zhag dang dus tshod re re bzhin 'gyur 'gro/ phra ba chos 630)nyid mi rtag pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'gyur 'gro/ rigs 'dra ba tsam rgyun ma chad pa byung ba 'di 'dra ba gzhan byung gi 'khrul rgyus bslad de gcig tu 'dzin pa red ma gtogs/ don du skad cig ma re re bzhin snga ma 'gags/ phyi ma gsar pa skye bas mi rtag pa yin/ dus mtha'i skad cig zer rgyu/ se gol gcig gtog pa'i yun la cha drug cu re'i cha re la dus mtha'i skad cig zer/ me tog gi 'dab ma drug cu brtsegs nas ( sdong brtsegs byed ni ? )de khab kyis phug na se gol gcig brdab yun la phug 'gro/ 'dab ma gong ma ma phug par 'og ma phug thab med/ 'dab ma re re phug yun la skad gcig zer ba yin/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad skad gcig re re bzhin 'gyur 'gro rgyu 'di la 'dus byas mi rtag pa zer ba yin/ lus gcig ma red/ du ma red/ rus dum re re bzhin so so yin/ ngag 631)gtam sna tshogs du ma yin/ sems rnam rtog 'dra mi 'dra bzhin ci dran grangs bzhin du ma yin/ lus dge mi dge'i gzhan dbang*/ ngag sems kyi gzhan dbang*/ sems yul gyi gzhan dbang can yin/

sems yul la mi spro/ mi bsdu/ phyam gyis 636)bskyur/ yengs la bor/ mi bcol mi 'dzin/ mi bsgom/ bcos pas mi rnyed/ btsal bas mi tshol/ lhod la bzhag ngang la bzhag de ltar bzhag pas/ yul la 'di 'di red bsam pa thams cad rnam rtog red/ rnam rtog thams cad rang yal la song*/ sa ra has/ ma yengs sems kyis rang gis rang la ltos/ zhes gsungs pas/ kha nang du log tsam/ lta tsam skyong tsam byas pa'i mtshams de shed nas/ rang gi khog pa'i nang shes pa med zer na ro yin dgos pa las shes pa zhig yod ni yod/ snga ma'i shes pa rnams dang gtan nas mi 'dra/ yul sngo ser dkar dmar sogs/ 'das ma 'ongs sogs kyi dus rnams la snang ni snang*/ go ni go/ tshor ni tshor/ go mkhan tshor mkhan shes mkhan zhig ni yin pa/ rta sga ma rgyab pa la rta dbyi li ma zer ba'i 637)dpe de bzhin du sems rnam rtog zhig yin tshar nas bzung yul dus la dpyad cing 'dzin mi zhig ma gtogs yod mi srid pa lta bu yin na yang*/ da res 'di ni de sngon gyi sems dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba yul snang yang 'dzin mi shes/ rtog mi shes/ dpyod mi shes/ shes pa yin kyang yul 'dzin pa'i gos dang bral ba shes pa g.yi li ma sngar gyi rnam rtog yul 'dzin de gtan nas min pa zhig i 'dug lta dgos/ rnam rtog go mkhan/ shes mkhan 'di min pa zhig ni yod dgos/ rnam rtog gi go dus shes dus shes lugs ni/ yul ka ba dang bum pa lta bu zhig la dmigs nas 'di ka ba red bsam gzung rnam skye/ ka ba 'di ring du/ thung du/ yag tu/ mi yag tu bsam nas yang yang dpyod pa'i 'dzin rnam skye ba yin/ ngo bo kha nang du log 638)tsam 'khor tsam byas pas rjen sang nge yod pa zhig yin/ yang mig gi yar bskor phyi bskor byas pas/ yul khra lam lam mthong dus yul 'di dang 'di red bsam long med/ de skabs rnam rtog gzhan skyes med pas/ khog pa'i nang gsal lhang nge*/ dwangs sal le/

650)/yongs dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis gzigs pa na// gnas lugs chos rnams mngon par sangs rgyas nyid// de ltar sems nyid 'od gsal rdzogs pa che// sems kyi chos nyid rang byung ye shes de// chos kyi po'i gol sa chod// gsal bar 'dug pas stong 651)pa'i gol sa chod// de bzhin tshogs brgyad gol sa bcad pa yang*// yid kyi rnam shes mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// phyi ru yul lnga spyod pa'i bdag por byed// nang du de la bzung ba'i nyon mongs yid// gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis kyi bdag po yin// de yi phyir na rnam par rtog pa rnams// rang gi rig pa dag gi rtsal yin te// 'dzin med gsal ba'i rig pa de nyid ni// rig pa 'gyus kyang 'dzin pa'i rdzas med de// phyi ru yul la spyad kyang ma bzung na// lta ba zang thal yin te yid las ldog tshogs bdun dag la rtog pa mi dpog na// sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi de las chos can tshogs brgyad rnam shes ni// lam gyis gtan la dbab bya'i don dam yin// sems kyi chos nyid rig stong gnyug ma yi// ye shes rang byung 'dus ma byas pa yi// ngo sprod bya rgyu'i 'od gsal sems yin te// sems kyi dkyil 'khor

652)rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gsang sngags de kho na nyid 'di yin te// grol lam bzhi pa'i dbang don 'di nyid yin// thabs lam rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa yis// 'char rgyu'i don gyi lhan skyes 'di yin gyi// 'dus byas sems dang dngos med stong rkyang min// don de man ngag ngo 'phrod med pa'i blo// stong nyid 'dus ma byas pa yin mod kyi// gsal rig bde rnams 'dus byas yin snyam pa// zung 'jug ma rtogs dbang las 'byung ba ste// gsal rig zhes pa mtshan mar dmigs yin na// 'dus byas yin kyang stong gsal tshig brjod kyang*// de gnyis tha dad mtshan ma phra rab tsam// dmigs pa med pas ris med mtshan ma med// ka dag rig par 'dus byas gdags gzhi med// 'di lta bu yi zung 'jug ma rtogs par// gsal ba zer na 'dus byas zhig la go stong pa zer na dngos med zhig la go zung 'jug zer na dngos dang dngos med gnyis// lhan cig tshogs pa cam las mi shes pas// de kho na nyid stong rkyang zhig la bzung*// de shes blo ni 'dus byas zhig bzung nas// mdo yi stong nyid bshad na de nyid 'chad// sngags 653) kyi lhan skyes 'od gsal bshad na yang*// lam ni thabs ni mi 'dra ba tsam las// mthar thug de las bogs dbyung med pa zhig 'dod tshe 'do don go yul tsam yang dka'// rdzogs chen rig pa rang ngo 'phrod pa na// 'dus ma byas yin mngon sum thag chod de// chos nyid gnyug ma'i sems kyang zhes bya ste// rang gsal cha nas rig pa'i ming btags kyang*// 'dus byas tshogs brgyad bsdus pa'i sems ma yin// bag chags sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i 'pho 'gyur can// sems med pas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes min// tshogs drug yul dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo// de'i yul gyur pa'i mtshan ma med pas na// sgo lnga yid dang nyon yid ji ltar yin// phyi nang mtshan ma ci yang mi dmigs pa// nam mkha' lta bur dngos mtshan gang yang med// stong pa zang thal rang gsal mngon mthong yang*// gsal rig de la dmigs gtad bya ba'i gzhi// mtshan ma'i rnam pa rdul tsam ye nas med// rgyu rkyen gang gi bskyed ces gdags su med// rang byung ye stong chen po rang 'od gsal// yin pas rang byung ye shes

654)chen por brjod// de ni 'od gsal ye shes chos nyid yin// man ngag med rnams yid ni mi ches kyang*// chos nyid rig pa de ni med ma yin// sngags su ma zad thun mong theg par yang*// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// bde gshegs snying po 'di la brjod pa yin// gnas lugs rang byung ye shes ma rtogs par// theg brgyad sems la lam du byas pa'i mthar// rdzogs chen ye shes rtogs nas sangs rgya'o// ye shes sems las byung ba ma yin te// sems kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin 'od gsal yin// dngos kun stong nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs yin// dngos po las ni 'byung ba min pa bzhin// ye nas gnas pa'i rang byung snying po 'di// rgyu las ma byung rkyen gyis ma bskyed pas// rtsol ba gang yang ma byas chos sku ru// rang byung ye shes yin par yid kyang ches// de ltar gzhi gnas gnyug ma'i rig pa ni// rang byung ye shes dmigs gtad med pa yi// chos nyid de las nam yang mi g.yo bzhin// rang gdangs lhun grub snang ba rang shar dang*// 'od gsal rtags snang rnams kyang thabs las snang*/ 655)/de tshe shes rab rang byung sgron ma yis// yul dang yul chan gzung 'dzin med pa ru// chos nyid rang gdangs shes pa thod rgal yin// 'char gzhi gzhir gnas gnyug ma'i rig pa ste// rtogs rgyu rig pa rtogs byed shes rab bo// sems dang bag chags sangs rgyas dngos ma yin// rig pa'i ye shes sems dang bag chags bral/ yid kyi ye shes mi mthong gsal mi ster// ye shes rtog med yid la 'gyu byed yod// yid kyis sangs rgyas lam la sgrib pa yin// mdor na sems klong man ngag sde rnams su// sems las 'das pa'i ye shes gtan la dbab// 'di don mthar thug shes 'dod blo mchis na// kun mkhyen snga phyi gsum gyi gsung las shes// deng sang gzhung lugs mang du thos pa dang*// sems 'dzin nyams myong than thun skyes na yang*// snyan rgyud man ngag rig ngo ma 'phrod pas// rdzogs chen ye shes 'dus byas yin no zer// de la rdzogs pa chen po zer ba ni// (

dbang ? )bzhi pa'i dbang don rig stong ye shes yin// bla mas ngo sprod gtan la dbab bya'i lam// 'dus byas yin min dpyad gzhi 'di yin la// sems kyi chos nyid rang 'byung ye shes yin/ 656)/do las chos kyi dbyings la tha dad med// chos dbyings rang 'od gsal ba yin pas de// sems kyi chos nyid ye nas bzhugs pa yi// gnas lugs yin pas 'dus ma byas chen po// gnas lugs de yi dbang du byas pa na// dus gsum chos rnams mnyam nyid 'pho 'gyur med// gnyis chos spros pa med par go dgos kyi// 'dus byas skad cig ma yi rnam shes zhig chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs ma yin pas// de ngo sprad pas de nyid ci la rtogs// des na rdzogs chen rig stong ye shes ni// gnyug ma 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes yin// 'di ni gnas lugs nges nas gzhal dgos pas// 'dus byas gnas lugs skad cig ma yin pa'i// de nyid ngo sprod rdzogs chen rgyud rnams dang*// rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma sus kyang ma bstan pas// rdzogs chen 'dus byas zer ba'i than skad 'di// bzhad gad bya 'os mnyan 'os ma yin no// de ltar rig ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang la mnyam bzhag tshe// tshogs brgyad rnam shes thams cad de'i ngang las// ma g.yos 657)rtogs bya rtogs byed tha dad med// gal te yid phra gnyug sems yin srid na// ye thog gzhi yi 'od gsal yin dgos te// dus gsum 'gyur med chos nyid yin pa'i phyir// de ltar yin na ye thog gzhi tsam la// 'khrul pa med la grol ba med ces gsungs// yid phra yod na sems can ci phyir mis// gzugs med 'du shes med pa'i sems can bzhin// de na 'khrul yod grol med 'dod dgos so// ye thog dus kyi yid phra'i gnyug sems de// ngar 'dzin gnyis 'dzin can zhig yin nam min// yin na sgrib bcas 'khor ba'i sems yin gyi// sgrib bral 'od gsal sems ni ga la yin// gnyug sems gshis la sgrib pa yod na de// 'khor bas bsdus kyi myang 'das ma bsdus 'gyur// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal lung dang 'gal// des na gnyug sems chos nyid stong pa nyid// rang bzhin stong rkyang bem stong ma song chas// 'od gsal sems dang rang byung ye shes zhes// brten nas skye dang brten nas btags pa yi// dngos dang dngos med chos las 'das pa de// so so rang gi rig pas rtogs

658)bya yin// tshogs brgyad shes pa'i cha dag bstun du med// de la gnyis chos mtshan ma ye nas med// 'od gsal spangs ba'i stong nyid dmigs su med// rtogs na dbyer med gnas lugs chen por rtogs// de la stong nyid 'od gsal rig stong sogs// dbye ba rjes kyi rtogs pas phyogs re'i mtha'// mi gnas pa yi tshul du brjod yin gyi// de nyid don la gnyis su dbye ba med// de ni thabs grol man ngag la brten nas// rtogs par bya yi rtog ge'i rigs pas min// rgyu rkyen skye 'gag med pas 'dus ma byas// yin yang dngos med 'dus ma byas de min// gdod nas skye med 'od gsal chen po la// skye 'gag skad cig med pas mnyam pa nyid// rtog med spros pa'i mtshan ma gang yang med// dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas nam mkha' bzhin// rtag dang mi rtag dngos dang dngos med dang*// rtag chad la sogs gnyis chos kun las 'das// gnyis snang rtog pas nam yang gzhal bya min/ kha gcig na re gzhi yi gnyug sems des// stong nyid rtogs pa 659)yod dam med ces zer// gzhir gnas gnyug mar rtogs dang ma rtogs kyi// tha snyad med de rig stong zung du 'jug rnam rtog gang gis ma bslad chos nyid rang*// rtogs dag ma rtogs gzhi la mi bzhag gi gzhi de rtogs bya'i de nyid gnas pa la// gzhi snang shar nas gzhi de rtogs pa'am// ma rtogs pa las grol 'khrul 'gyur nas na// de la ltos nas sangs rgyas sems can btags// re zhig rtogs byed yid kyi rnam shes kyis// gzhir gnas gnyug ma'i sems de rtogs pa'i dus// rtogs mkhan de yis stong nyid rtogs zhes bya// sems can rnams kyis yod kyang ma rtogs par// gnyis snang zhen pas ma rtogs zhes bya'o// gzhi snang rtsal la 'khrul grol gnyis yod kyi// gzhi las rtogs dang ma rtogs sbyar du med// dbyer med yin phyir snang tshul dbang byas na// so skye nas bzung sangs rgyas sa yi bar// spangs rtogs je bzang nyid du 'gro dgos shing*// de yang sgom po'i rgyud kyi tshogs brgyad kyi// blo yis sgom pa tsam las 'os med la/

khyad par yid kyi rnam par shes pa yi// dbang don ngo 'phrod dgos pa gzhir bcas te// 'di ru ma zad theg 660)dgu gang gi lam// thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis gzhal rnams// yid shes gtso bor gyur pa yin pas na// yid kyis bsgom pa min pa med mod kyi// yid kyis bsgom tshad yid yin ga la dgos// stong nyid yid kyis bsgom pa yin mod kyang*// yid ma yin te de yi yul yin phyir// yid shes rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa yang*// sems kyi chos nyid rig stong zung 'jug de// bsgom pa yin gyi tshogs drug yid ma yin// yid kyis stong pa bdag med bsgom na yang*// stong dang bdag med yid yin mi dgos pa// de bzhin yid de skye med rtogs pa'i dus// skye med de las tha dad yid gzhan du// med kyang skye med yid du mi 'gyur bzhin// rang sems skye med kho thag chod pa'i dus// yid nyid gdod nas skye med mngon sum mthong*// skye med de las tha dad pa yi yid// rnam shes cha ni rdul tsam ma dmigs bzhin// gsal cha 'gags pa med par rang gsal ba// gsal stong zung 'jug ngo bo de lta bur// sems kyi chos nyid ces bya de'i ngang na// tshogs brgyad kun kyang du ma ro gcig mnyam// brjod bral so so rang gis 661)rig byar gnas// de yi nang nas phra yid ces bya ba'i// rdzogs chen 'dus byas ngos 'dzin ci zhig srid// yid phra rdzogs chen yin la yid rags pa/ rdzogs chen min lugs ci 'dra yin zhes shod// chos nyid rig stong gnyug ma de'i ngang las/ 'khor 'das snang ba shar yang de las shar// grol yang de la grol bar rdzogs chen gyi// rnal 'byor pas ni dngos su nyams myong na// chos rnams gzhi rtsa gnyug ma ma yin par// yid phra sgom la yon tan ci zhig yod// de phyir yid shes rdzogs chen sgom pa'i blo// blo des stong dang gsal ba zung 'jug sogs// tshig gi lam gyi dmigs pa la dmigs nas// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can du bsgom de srid// gzung 'dzin can gyi rnam shes nyid yin gyi// rdzogs pa chen po'i phyogs su mi phyin la// nam zhig rang sems rig sto chos nyid che// yul dang yul can med par thad ka ru// lag mthil skyu ru'i 'bras rlon bzhag pa bzhin// thag chod tshe na rdzogs chen rig pa ni// ngo 'phrod ces ni tha snyad 'dogs yin na// de las gzhan du bshad

662)pas ci zhig bya// de nyid rtogs byed thabs su zhu bde dang*// sems dben sogs kyang bsgom pa'i dbang byas na// rim lngar bshad pa'i gnyug sems 'od gsal kyang*// chos nyid rang byung ye shes nyid yin gyi// tshogs brgyad bye brag phra yid ma yin te// 'dus byas cha zhig gnas lugs ga la yin// rdzogs chen ngo sprod thebs nas de nyid la// goms pas dmigs bcas gzhan ni ma bsgom kyang*// gnyid 'thug skabs su 'od gsal dwangs pa ni// nam mkha' rkyen med lta bur 'char ba de// rdzogs chen lam la myong ba ci rigs pa// thon pa tshun gyi mngon sum nyid yin la// da lta'i rig pa rjen pa de la ni// rnam rtog bslad pa rdul tsam med pa nyid// myong las gzhan du rtogs bya ci yang med// chos nyid rang byung ye shes shar yin gyi// tshogs drug 'gags rjes yid phra 'dus byas des// go yul stong nyid sgom pa ga la yin// gsal stong mtha' dbus med par gyur pa la// de la dpyod byed rnam rtog ga la yod// srab mo'i 'od gsal sems dben sgom rnams la// snang gsum lugs ldog lugs 'byung 663)'char tshul dang*// ngos 'dzin dpyod byed phra mo ma 'gags pa// yid phra yin tsam 'ba' zhig nyams myong la// bsam nas chos nyid gzhi yi 'od gsal kyang*// de 'dra yin snyam 'di ni 'thad ma yin// yid phra 'dus byas yin pas rkyen bzhi las// skye ba yin dgos 'di yi rkyen bzhi dang*/ khyad par dmigs rkyen gang yin dpyad dgos la// thog med dus nas tha ma'i bar dag tu// rgyun chags ma yin gnyug sems su mi 'gyur// rgyun du yod na rnam rtog rags pa yis// bslad ma zhugs pa'i sems ni 'dus byas zhig sems can kun gyi rgyud la yod pa na// sems des rang yul shes sam mi shes grang*// shes na chags sogs de la cis mi skye// ma shes stong nyid dpyod pa'i go yul rags// de la gsar du ji ltar bslab nas bsgom// dgra bcom 'gog pa'i tshe na phra yid de// 'gags sam mi 'gags 'gags na gnyug ma min// rkyen gyis 'gyur ba'i phyir dang ma 'gags na// lhag med dus na skad cig sems yod cing*// de ni sangs rgyas sar yang mi ldog pas// yid kyi rang bzhin phung po'i rgyu ma log

664)/de sogs mtha' yas skyon ni bsal mi nus// snang tshul kho na'i dbang du byas na ni// sngar bzhin yid kyis bsgom la 'os med pas// de ni rkyen las skyes pa'i skye 'gag can// yin phyir sgom dang mi sgom yod pa las// 'char lugs med phyir lam ni 'dus byas su// sus kyang khas len pa las 'os med do// de phyir gnas lugs 'dus ma byas yin pas// blo dang chos rnams de las ma 'das kyang*// de yis 'dus ma byas su khas blang na// thams cad de ltar dgos pas skyon mtha' yas// 'on kyang lam ni rig stong rjen pa'am// thabs lam snang gsum mtha' yi 'od gsal de// rang bzhin 'od gsal dmigs bya dmigs byed med// de la ji ltar 'dus byas gdags snyam na// chos nyid ngos nas gzhal na 'dus ma byas// yin mod de tshe gnyis snang bag chags sam// thabs lam snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags ni// ma zad pa yi gang zag yin pas na// lam gyi skabs su skad cig rgyun can du// snang las mi 'das snang tshul 'dus byas brjod// bag chags zad nas mngon sangs rgyas pa'i dus// chos dbyings de las nam yang mi g.yo ba// rdo rje lta bu rtag pa chen po'i sku// 'dus ma byas 665)chen yin te 'dus byas min// snang tshul bral 'bras yin pas gsar byung dang*// phrin las rim can 'jug pas 'dus byas su// 'jog sogs lung spyir grang ltar so so yi// dgongs don shan 'byed the tshom drwa ba bral// gzhan dag ngo bo mi rtag rgyun gyi rtag /sku dang ye shes rang gi ngo bos rtag snang tshul rgyud gyis mi rtag spyi mdor gsungs// gnas lugs mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin// ji snyed chos kun ma 'dres 'char ba gnyis// gcig gi phyogs bzung gcig spang mi dgos par// zab mo brgyad ldan rtogs tshul gsungs pa bzhin// bden gnyis 'gal med go don legs shar la// mdo rgyud dgongs par nges shes 'phrog med skye/

skabs dang po'o/// sems kyi chos nyid rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i dus// chos can thams cad dag pa'i rang bzhin 'char// gzhan pa'i sems zhes bya ba rdul tsam med// snang tshul gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin ma zin// de ni chos sku dngos min da lta'i gzhi// chos sku'i rgyu tsam yin par 'dod mod kyang*// ye thog gzhi dus kho na'i dbang byas na// grol 'khrul med pas sangs rgyas sems can med// rtogs zin 'khrul zin gang yang mi 666)srid do// gzhi snang shar tshe grol 'khrul gnyis yod de// rtogs dang ma rtogs pa las byung ba yin// rtogs pa mngon gyur sangs rgyas yin pas na// stobs bcu la sogs yon tan mngon gyur yod// gzhi la yon tan ye ldan du yod kyang*// sangs rgyas ma gtogs sa bcu'i sems dpas kyang*// mngon gyur med na phal pas lta ci smos// gzhi yi yon tan snang dang mi snang ni// gzhi tsam kho na'i ngos nas ma yin te// rtogs dang ma rtogs snang ngor ltos nas phye// gzhi ni 'gyur ba med pas gnyug ma yin// grol 'khrul rtsal las shar bas glo bur yin// gzhi las ma g.yos 'khor 'das mi snang bas// stong gsal mtha' bral chen po tsam du gnas// dag pa'i yon tan dbyer med yin na yang*// so sor 'byed med bsam gyis mi khyab pa// slob pa'i gnyis snang nub pa'i mnyam bzhag bzhin// stobs bcu yul can ye shes de nyid kyis// yul la mkhyen tshul sgo nas 'byed dgos phyir// 'o na dag pa'i yon tan 'char rung tsam// 'dod dam zhe na gzhi yi ldog cha nas/ khas blangs snang tshul dbang byas mi rung med// gzhi la yon tan lhun rdzogs mi rung bas// gzhi nyid khyab tshad 667)'bras bur mi rigs te// rang bzhin rnam dag tsam du khas len gyi// dag pa gnyis ldan sangs rgyas min snyam na// de 'dra'i ye thog gzhi las ma g.yos dus// sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med khas len min// gnyis su med na su yis gnyis su dbye// des na gzhi snang g.yos te gnyis snang dus// gzhi dus sems can phung khams skye mched rnams// ye nas sgrib bral rang bzhin rnam dag tu// gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pas dag pa 'grub// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su snang na yang*// srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa yang*// mnyam pa chen po'i chos nyid yin pas 'grub// de ltar gtan dbab de goms mthar phyin pas// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa dag pa'i tshe// sgrib cha zad pas chos nyid ji lta ba// mngon du gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung*// de la mnyam par bzhag bzhin chos can kun// chos nyid de las nam yang 'dar med pas// bden gnyis gcig char gzigs pa sangs rgyas chos// stobs sogs yon tan thams cad mngon du gyur// chos nyid gshis la sgrib pas gos med kyang*// sems can rnams kyi mngon gyur lta ci smos// 'phags pa slob pas ci

668)rigs mngon gyur yang*// sangs rgyas bzhin du stobs bcu'i ye shes med// stobs sogs yon tan bgrang 'das de dag kyang*// dbyings kyi yon tan yin gyi gzhi ma yin// dbyings de rang bzhin rnam dag yin pas na// longs sku'i zhing dang bkod pa'i rnam par gnas// da lta ma dag pa yi snang ba yang*// dbyings ye'i snang las gzhan du ma gyur phyir// yon tan mngon du gyur rung ma gyur rung*// dag dang ma dag snang rung ma snang rung*// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos rnams ma lus pa// sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan du rdul tsam med// ma dag 'khor ba ltar snang gzhi rnams kun// dag pa' 'bras bur gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ snang srid ye sangs rgyas pa'i dgongs pa nyid// lta bas gtan la dbab pa'i tshul yin no// de ltar lta bas ji ltar bcas pa ltar// bsgom pas nyams blangs spyod pas bogs bton pas// mngon gyur mthar phyin sangs rgyas bar du 'byung*// lta ba dag mnyam chen por gtan la phab// mngon gyur snang tshul la yang sangs rgyas te// ye sangs rgyas la lam gyis bsgrub med par// goms pa rdzogs nas mngon gyur sangs rgyas yin// don des gdod ma'i mgon po mngon byas te// gzhi snang gzhi thog grol bas thog 669)ma'i mgon// de phyir ye sangs rgyas par 'dod dgos so// sems can rnams la 'khrul par skyes zin pas// 'khrul pa spang yod sangs rgyas min snyam na// gzhi la 'khrul pa med pas gzhi snang dus// 'khrul pa rang bzhin med par rnam kun nges// rang bzhin rnam dag nyid las ma 'das phyir// des na 'khrul pa can gyi sems can ngor// gzhi 'bras dbyer med nyid du mi 'char yang*// 'khrul snang yin pas dbang btsan mi bya ste// mig dang sna ba sna yang tshad ma min// lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min// gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na// 'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya// des na ye shes gzigs pa dbang btsan dgos// kun tu bzang sogs dus gsum rgyal ba yis// spang bya ye med rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings// zag med yon tan kun ldan gzigs yin gyi// sems can rnams kyi mthong ltar mi gzigs la// spang bya rnams kyang yod par mi gzigs te// de phyir sems can phal nas rgyun mtha'i bar// dbang gis ma yin sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi

/dgongs pa dus gsum 'gyur med mnyam pa nyid// de yi dbang byas lta bas gtan la phab/ 670)/de las lhag pa'i sngags kyi grub mtha' med// de nyid mthar thug don du shes par bya// de ltar rgyal bas chos nyid ji bzhin rtogs// dbyings ye gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sku// nam mkha' ji srid bar du rtag cing brtan// 'khor ba'i snang ba mi brtan ldog pa yin// de phyir gzhi nyid don dam chos nyid sku// rtogs bya chos sku dngos yin de rtogs pas// dbyings dang gnyis med chos can ji snyed pa// gzigs pa'i ye shes chos sku 'grub pa dang*// gsal ba longs sku'i 'char gzhi mthar thug yin// 'od lnga'i gdangs las longs skur 'char ba dang*// thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku'i 'char gzhi yin// gzhi dus sku gsum dbyer med rig pa 'di// ngo bo nyid sku'i ngo bor byang chub ste// de las mi g.yo dri mas gos ma myong*// de ltar yin na 'khrul pa gang las 'byung*// 'khrul pa dbyings la nam yang yod min te// dbyings 'khrul mi srid 'o na su 'khrul na// dbyings las snang ba'i steng nas bdag 'dzin pas// dbyings don ma rtogs pa las 'khrul pa byung*// dbyings snang steng nas dbyings rtogs kun tu bzang*// dbyings kyi ngo bo grol 'khrul ka nas dag /snang ba'i dus kyang de las gzhan mi g.yo/ 671)/ma g.yos bzhin du gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'phrul// 'khor 'das snang ba rgya che mu med pa// snga mtha' phyi mtha'i dus la gtugs pa med// phyogs kyi dbye ba'i mtha' la thug med pa// mdor na chos dbyings mtha' klas snang ba kun// dus dang phyogs char 'byed pa med pa yi// rtsal du shar zhing rgyan dang rol par bkod// rdzogs chen dus gsum dus med rtogs pa la// phyogs bcu dus gsum chos kun ma rdzogs med// de phyir gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dus gsum du// 'dzin 'di sems can rnams kyi snang tshul yin// gnas tshul dbang du de ltar grub pa med// gnas snang rnam pa kun tu mthun pa yis// gzigs ngo'i dbang byas chos rnams ye sangs rgyas// rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung gi bzhed pa 'di// mthar thug dpyod pa'i rigs pas grub pa yin// de ma yin par sus kyang brgal mi nus// de nyid rtogs na nges don sangs rgyas 'grub// de las lhag pa'i lam ni gzhan na med// rlung bcings 'od gsal nyi tshe ba la sogs// mtshan bcas lam la nam yang ltos mi dgos// snang grags dran rtog sku gsung thugs 'khor lo// ston pa sku gsum nyid kyang 'di las byung*// rang byung ye shes spros pa med pa la// rtogs dang ma rtogs gnyis

672)chos tha snyad med// sems la rtogs dang ma rtogs gnyis su yod// de phyir sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal de// lam gyi rtogs bya ye gnas de bzhin nyid// rtogs byed blo ni thos bsam bsgom pa yi// shes rab yin la rnam rtog ma 'gags skabs// yid yin yid des chos nyid ngo 'phrod dus// yid kyang chos nyid de yi ngang du rtogs// de la gzung 'dzin tha dad ming med do// des na rtogs dang ma rtogs tha snyad 'di// gzhi la med kyang de shar blo las yin// ngo 'phrod rgyun bskyang goms pa chags pa'i tshe// sgo lnga yid la de yang kun gzhi la// de nyid gzhi yi chos nyid la thim tshe// tshogs brgyad gtan nas log ste med na yang*// chos nyid rig gdangs rang byung shes rab nyid// goms las slong byed rkyen bral nam mkha' ltar// nang gi mngon byang 'od gsal ngos zin 'byung*// phal rnams gnyid 'thug 'chi dus tshogs brgyad log gnyug sems mi ldog yod kyang ngos mi zin// de skabs sems med mun pa'i gnas skabs bya// thabs lam pa rnams bskyed rim rdor bzlas sogs// sngon po snying ga'i nā dar sems zin pa'i// smig rgyu la sogs rtags kyi rnam pa dang*// snang gsum mtha' yi 673)sprin med nam mkha' ltar// nyams skyes de tshe yid phra ma 'gags pas// gzhi yi 'od gsal dngos min cha 'dra yin// goms na rtogs pa don gyi 'od gsal 'gyur// gzhan yang mtshan mo a dkar sems bzung bas// gnyid dus 'od gsal cha 'dra shar ba dang*// nam mkha' sum phrug logs man ngag gis// 'char sogs mdor na yid ni dang mtshan pas// gzung 'dzin sgom pas cha 'dra shar ba rnams// ri mor bris pa'i zla ba lta bur yin// rdzogs chen rig pa thad dkar thag chod na// dpe yi 'od gsal chu nang zla gzugs bzhin// 'di ni mthong lam yin te de'i yon tan// lus rgyas sgrib pas med ces phal cher bzhed// chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams pas// mthong lam dngos min de nyid rtogs pa yin// mthong lam yin na yon tan brgya bcu gnyis// yod dgos 'di ni rang rig mngon sum ste// dpe yi ye shes yin la de goms pas// don gyi ye shes zla ba dngos mthong ltar// yon tan snang nus byung dus mthong lam bzhed// des na tshogs brgyad yid dang de 'das pa'i// ye shes rang rtsal dpyod byed shes rab gnyis// chos rnams rnam par 'byed la mtshan nyid mtshungs// de bas ye shes

674)ma shar rnam shes la// de bas gnyug sems yid phra yin no smra// de ni shin tu nor te gnyug sems dang*// bde gshegs snying po don dam byang chub sems// zhes sogs ming tha dad kyang don la gcig /'od gsal 'dus ma byas las 'khor 'das su// snang yang de nyid 'khor 'das grub pa min// sems can rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i yid 'di ni// rkyen bzhi las skyes 'dus byas ma dag sems// nyi tshe'i rgyud bsdus gzung dang 'dzin pa can// kun la khyab min ris su chad sogs yin// de de yin na lnga po der 'gyur la// de 'dra rdzogs chen gzhung las bstan pa med// rdzogs chen rig pa byang chub sems klong las// 'khor 'das snang yang de las gzhan ma gyur// snang srid rnam dag ye sangs rgyas pa'i zhing*// rtsol ba med par lhun gyis grub pa 'di// rtsol yod rdzogs pa chen po'i khyad chos yin// yid phra chos nyid gnyug ma'i sems yin na// gzhi yi 'od gsal de las byung ngam ci// byung na 'od gsal sngon du de yod dgos// mar me mdzad sogs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// brtan g.yo thams cad des khyab 'dod dam ci// de nyid rtogs na snang srid 'khor 'das chos// rang bzhin rnam dag 'gyur la ci 675)zhig phan// des sngar stong nyid bsgom ma myong ba la// gsar du stong nyid bsgom na rnam mkhyen rgyu// yin par khyed rang khas ni ma blangs sam// des na de rtogs lam du byas pa las// gzhi yi chos nyid ngos ni mi zin pas// de ni sems yin gnyug sems ga la yin// gnyug sems sems la chu la brlan khyab bzhin// chos nyid yin na 'di ni chos can la// kun gzhi kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid rags pa// sgo lnga'i shes pa gang dang mi 'dres ste// de rnams 'di la med par khas blangs phyir// des na tshogs drug ma 'gags pa'i skabs su// thos bsam shes rab rdzogs chen ngo sprod du// med na grol lam man ngag mthar thug tu// gsungs pa don med 'gyur zhing de'i gams ngag

nyan na ngo 'phrod mi srid gzhung thams cad// don med 'gyur na de yi skyon med de// tshogs drug yod dus yid phra ma 'gags par// yod pa de la ngo sprod bya snyam na// phra rags don med da lta'i shes pa 'di// skye med ngo 'phrod gzhi 'od rtogs yin gyi// rags par med la phra bar yod don ci// gzhan yang gnyug sems nam yang mi ldog na// skye ba len po 676)sangs rgyas po yin pas// gang zag bdag tu 'dod na skyon ci yod// mi rtag pa'i phyir 'di bdag min snyam na// mi rtag bdag zhig khas blangs 'di la 'grig /gzhi lam chos nyid mi rtag par 'dod dam// des na yid phra med pa'i chos nyid kyi// ye shes 'od gsal sems zhig yod par grub// chos nyid sems las gzhan pa'i sems gzhan ni// 'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin ma brjod do// des na yid phrar gnyug sems 'dod pa nor// de gnyis rgyab 'gal rnam kun tha dad yin// yid phra kun rtog rags dus yod dam med// med na gnyug sems ma yin rgyun med phyir// yod na gcig tu yod dam tha dad yod// dang po ltar na da lta'i yid shes 'di// rags pa med pa'i phra yin yod dus rags// chos gcig gnyis su khas len 'gal ba sdud// tha dad yod na rkyen bzhi las skyes pa'i// rags las tha dad du ni yod dgos te// dngos po tha dad rgyu ni tha dad dbang*// de ltar yid kyi rgyud gnyis gang zag ni// gcig gi rgyud la nus mtshungs yod dgos so// yod kyang mi skyon tshogs brgyad yin snyam na// tshogs brgyad byed las cha nas dbye na yang*// nang du 677)skyes bu gcig gi shes rgyud gcig 'di ni rtag tu phra yi rags ma myong*// rags pa phra ba myong gnyis yod dgos na// sad dus rags dang rmi lam phra ba tsam// myong bas shes kyang 'di 'dra'i phra yod par// mngon sum rjes dpag lung gsum gang gis dpog phra der stong nyid bslab nas 'dzin rung na// des ni rags pa'i yul yang cis mi 'dzin// mi 'dzin chos rnams stong nyid ji ltar rtogs// des na de la bsgom bcug ci zhig bya// gzhan yang 'khor gsum rtog pa shes sgrib yin// de yi mi rtog gnyen po ye shes yin// slob lam ye shes mthar thug rdor ting gis// rnam rtog rtsad nas bcom pas sangs rgyas 'gyur// khams sum bsdus pa'i sems dang sems byung rnams/

rnam par rtog las ma 'das rnam shes yin// sems 'gag pa ste sku yi mngon sum mdzad// de dus gnyis snang bag chags med pa la// gnyis snang can gyi rnam shes ga la yod// mi rtog ye shes yod de sangs rgyas thugs// des ni chos rnams rnam rtog mi mnga' mkhyen// ye shes de la sems zhes mi bya ste// sems las 'das pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir// de ltar min na 678)drang nges go log 'gyur// des na med dgag stong nyid la dmigs pa'i// mi rtog ye shes zhig ni gtan nas med// bden med dmigs pas bden grub mi rtog mod// bden med nyid du rnam par cis mi rtog /rtog na dngos dang dngos med gang rtog kyang*// rnam rtog nyid yin ri bong rwa med du// rtog la rwa 'dzin med kyang rwa med bzhin// bden med rnam rtog ldog pa'i thabs med do// des na dgag rtog sgrub rtog gang yin yang*// rnam rtog nyid las 'da' bar mi srid la// mi rtog ye shes de gnyis gang yang min// des ni gang du yang ni mi rtog phyir/ kha cig dgag rtog yin te spros pa dgag spros bral sgrub pa'i rnam rtog yin snyam na// spros pa mtha' dag khegs par gyur pa la// spros bral snyam du 'dzin pa ga la yod// yod na da dung spros bral ga la yin// des na rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyis// stong nyid mngon sum byas zhes zer dgos kyang*// bden gnyis dbye ba'i don dam de ma yin// stong rkyang de la rtog na dgag rtog yin// bden gnyis dbyer med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid so so rang 679)gi rig pa'i yul// chos kyi dbyings dang stong nyid mthar thug yin// de nyid rtogs tshe rtogs bya rtogs byed zhes// tha snyad phye yang don la tha dad med// rnam par rtog pas bsdus pa'i rang bzhin can// gsal zhing rig pa rnam shes mtshan nyid yin// mi rtog gnas lugs so so rang gis rig

/rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes mtshan nyid yin// rnam par rtog pas bsdus pa'i rang bzhin can// gsal zhing rig pa rnam shes mtshan nyid yin// mi rtog gnas lugs so so rang gi rig /rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes mtshan nyid yin// rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid ye shes so// sgrib gnyis bag chags yongs su dag pa yi// ye shes mthar thug sangs rgyas mtshan nyid yin// chos nyid gzigs pa'i cha nas ji lta ba// chos can gzigs la ji snyed ye shes zhes// ldog chas btags kyang ngo bo tha dad med// bden gnyis dbyer med mthar thug gzigs pa yin// des na chos nyid ye shes chos can sems// gcig dang tha dad gang yang khas blangs min// 'dzam gling rgyan gcig kun mkhyen chos rjes kyang*// de gnyis tha snyad du ni gcig ma yin// sems rtogs pas na ye shes mi rtogs dang*// chos can chos nyid yin pa sogs kyi phyir// don dam tha dad du'ang ma yin te// sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas na// ye shes rtogs dus sems 680)kyang tha dad med// rang grol nyid du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir// chos nyid 'od gsal rang gi gnas lugs la// mkha' ltar sangs rgyas sems can kun khyab kyang*// so so'i chos nyid gud bcad snang tshul la// bum snang mkha' ltar ris chad du snang zhing*// rang rang ngo skal gzhi lam 'bras snang mod// don la chos nyid khyab brdal chen po las// snang bas tha dad so sor grub pa med// de phyir glo bur 'khrul pa'i snang tshul la// gcig grol tshe na kun grol 'gyur mi dgos// gcig 'khrul tshe na kun 'khrul mi 'gyur gyi// 'khrul grol gdod ma'i gzhi las byung ba 'dra// gdod ma'i chos nyid ye sangs rgyas pa nyid// srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs las sangs rgyas byung*// de phyir rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam thams cad// chos nyid gtan la phab nas de bsgom pas// 'bras bu thob phyir sngags kyi grub mtha' rnams// chos nyid rig pa'i dbang du byas pa yin// dbu ma'i lam kyang chos nyid bsgom yin gyi// chos can bsgom nas grol bar 'gyur ba ni// rgyu 'bras theg pa gang las ma gsungs so// don dam dbang byas de ltar

681)bsgom dgos kyang*// snang tshul tha snyad pa yi dbang byas na// gzhi yi skabs su sangs ni rgya rung rigs// lam ni nyams su len pa'i skabs dang ni// dag pa mthar phyin 'bras bu'i skabs gsum du// shan 'byed rdzogs chen bar gyi 'dod lugs gcig /lam mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas khas len gyi// de las ldog pa nam yang mi 'dod pas// gnas snang shan phyes the tshom mun pa dwangs// nges shes snang ba ldog med skye bar 'gyur// dbu ma ma 'brel sngags lam nyams blangs kyang*// thar pa mi thob zer la brtag bya ste// rdo rje theg las thabs grol ma gnyis bshad// grol ma bdag med rtogs pas ma grol na// dbu ma la mtshungs don la khyad par med// de ni dbu ma'i yin na dbu mar yang*// gang zag bdag med nyan thos yin zhes smros// dbu mar chos kyi bdag med rgyas bstan phyir// nyan thos der mi ltos na sngags lam na// rnam kun mchog ldan yod pas der mi ltos// thabs lam thabs kyis drangs pa'i lhan skyes che// dbu ma las kyang 682)khyad par 'phags yin na// des ni dbu ma'i go mi chod pa ci// des na sngags lam mdo la ltos mi dgos// mdo las khyad par 'phags pa'i myur lam yin// gzhan dag sems ni gsal stong tsam du ni// mdo lam gyis kyang gtan la dbab nus na// rdzogs chen myur lam ji ltar yin snyam na// mdo yi lam na bde gshegs snying po tsam// mdo sngags mtshams sbyor tshul du gsungs na yang*// de yi lam ni dngos su gsungs pa med// sngags kyi lam du dbang gis rgyud smin nas// rig pa ye shes cer phog ngo sprod yod/ khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs chen rang lam na// rlung bcings sogs kyi thabs la ltos min par// rig stong ye shes rjen par 'char 'di 'dra// dbu ma'i lam la yod de ci'i phyir mtshungs// dbu mas chos dbyings gtan la phab pa na// spros dang bral ba'i dbyings la gsungs mod kyang*// don de dbang po rnon pos grangs med gcig

/tshogs gnyis goms las mthong lam mngon byed kyi// de las myur bar thob par ma gsungs la// sngags las 683)dbang skur ngo sprod kyis stobs las// da lta nyid du dpe yi ye shes mthong*// ring min don gyi ye shes mngon du 'gyur// de gnyis lam gyi myur bul ji ltar mtshungs// int+ra bho dhi lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// cig char ba yang yod par ma gsungs sam// sems nyid gnyug ma'i 'od gsal mngon du byed// 'di dag dag pa'i srid zhi mnyam nyid dang*// gzugs sku 'od gsal rtags snang mngon byed pa// 'di dag dag pa'i zhing khams dag sbyor mtshungs// sku gnyis rang bzhin da lta lam byed pa// 'di 'dra dbu ma las kyang ma bshad pas// gsang sngags myur lam ci'i phyir ma yin// chos sku rig stong gnyug ma'i ye shes de// rlung bcing la sogs thabs la mi ltos par// bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho zhing ngo sprod pas// dgongs pa mngon du gyur la bsnyon du med// de ni bzhi pa'i don gyi ye shes yin// rlung thim zhu bdes drangs yang 'di las ci// des na sngags kyi mtshan bcas lam kun kyang*// mod las 'phags na rdzogs chen ci phyir min// mtshan bcas dpe las don ni 'tshol ba'i lam// rdzogs chen khregs thod chos gzugs mngon du byed// mdo lam stong nyid rjes dpag gtan la phab// da lta mngon sum yid ches bskyed thabs med// sngags kyi dpe yi ye shes chu zla ltar// 684)don gyi ye shes mtshon nus mdo las 'phags// don gyi ye shes zla ba dngos snang bzhin// gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du je cher 'phel// mthong ba yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas go 'phang de// snyigs dus tshe thung 'di la bsgrub nus shing*// de ma thob kyang bar dor mchog dngos grub/ khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yis// rig stong gnyum ma'i ye shes rjen cer mthong*// lus dang snang ba sku dang ngag rlung gsung*// dran rtog thugs dang dbyer med ye shes te// rdo rje bzhi dang sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor che// rlung thim la sogs thabs la mi brten par// mthong bas grol ba mngon sum lam du byed// sngags kyi yon tan thams cad yar ldan 'du// snang gsum 'pho ba rang zad rang dag la// song bas 'pho med rig pa ye shes sku// 'grub par myur lam kun gyi rtse mo yin// rtsol ba'i lam kun don gyi 'od gsal rgyu// 'di yis rtsol med don gyi 'od gsal mthong*// 'di las lhag pa'i sngags lam srid ma yin// gang snang thams cad chos sku'i rol par shar// 'bras bu mngon gyur gzugs sku rtsol med 'char// mi slob zung 'jug mngon du byed yin na// sgyu lus la'ang de las dgos pa ci/
685) /rgyud lung man ngag zab rgyas rgya mtsho'i chu// dad brtson rnam dpyod skya bas legs bsrub pas/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i legs bshad ke ta ka /gzur gnas don gnyer blo yi nor bur bkrun/

zhes pa'ang mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang po snga 'gyur theg pa mchog gi rang lugs 'dzin pa padma kun bzang bstan 'dzin nor bu'am/ 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros nyid kyis 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i don las 'phros pa'i dpyad pa the tshom drwa ba gcod pa'i ral gri zhes tshan gyi bsngags pa don dang ldan pa 'di la mjug gi bya ba yongs su rjogs par mdzad pa zin nas 'phros lus pa nyid la mjug yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dgos zhes nyid kyi dngos slob rnams kyis ched du bskul kyang khong gi ljags rtsom nyid dang 'dra ba rtsom pa'i nyams dngos dang shugs bstan gyi tshig nus khyad par phun sum tshogs la zhig rtsom dka' bar rigs te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mngon pa mdzod stod cha'i 'grel dang*/ chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma'i mngon sum le'u yan chad kyi 'grel pa bzhin 'dir yang 'phros lus pa rten 'brel phun tshogs pa'i yan lag tu nges par bya'o/ tshul khrims rgya mtshos so// 686) 687)༄༅/ bar do'i gdams pa mdor bsdus bzhugs/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'chi kha bar do'i gdams pa mi gsal ba gsal btab pa sgeg mos me long la blta ba lta bu 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi 'pho ba ni/ thod rgal nam mkha' sum sprugs te/ phyi'i nam mkha' dbyings rnam dag sgron ma/ nang gi nam mkha' rtsa ka ti shel sbug gsang ba'i nam mkha' shes rab rang byung sgron ma ste/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyi shes pa mig la gtad/ mig nam mkhar dbyings rig la gtad nas ngo bo bskyangs la 'pho ba'am/ khregs chod yul dang gnas la 'jug pa'i 'pho ba ni/ 'pho lung dngos yin pas dbugs rgod pa nas/ 'pho lung dmigs pa kho na gnad du bsnun/ thim rim kyang sa sa la thim pas lus lci/ ldang mi 688)nus/ chu chu la thim pas kha sna'i chu 'dzag me me la thim pas kha sna skam/ rkang pa'i drod shor/ rlung rlung la thim pas yan lag phra/ mig gyen la ldog lus kyi khrag srog rtsar 'dus la/

rlung rnam shes la thim pas/ dkar lam dmar lam/ nag lam rnams kyi rjes/ rig pa snying dkyil brgyal/ nang dbugs chad/ de nas chos nyid bar dor rang snang la yid ches pa ma pang bu 'jug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag la/ rnam shes nam mkha' la thim pa ni/ lus pos 'brel thag chad pa na/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ston ka'i nam mkha' la sprin dang bral ba lta bu 'char bas ngos zin par byas te gshis thog tu bzhag pas grol/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa ni/ gang du bltas kyang za 'og kha phyes pa lta bu/ kha dog sna tshogs 'gul 689)'khrig gi rnam pa can 'char bas rig pa'i rang snang yin par thag bcad/ lta thog tu bzhag pas grol/ 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim pa ni/ khro bo'i snang ba sgra 'od zer dang bcas pa bsngangs skrag skye ba tsam du 'char/ de nas zhi ba'i snang ba/ rnam snang*/ rdor sems/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ don grub bcas kyi gtso 'khor gyi tshom bu 'char/ de dag gi tshe'ang ka dag rang ngo shes pa dang thod rgal gyi rang snang nyag gcig yin par thag bcad pas grol/ de nas zung 'jug ye shes la thim pa ni/ ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba ni/ snying ga nas 'od kyi snang ba thag pa nam mkha' la zug pa lta bu la/ snying ga'i snam bu'i steng*/ thig le mthing ga lnga tshom/ de steng dkar po 'dra ba/ de steng ser po/ de steng dmar po/ de steng 'od zlum po bcas 690)'char/ de dag gi khregs chod kyi rang ngo bskyang pa dang*/ snang cha rnams rang gi rig mdangs kho na yin par shes na grol/ de nas ye shes lhun grub la thim pa ni/ sngar gyi snang ba rnams 'od zlum la 'dus pa las/ steng na ka dag gi snang ba/ de 'og khro bo/ de 'og zhi ba phyogs mtshams rnams rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing*/ 'og na rigs drug gi snang ba dang bcas pa lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang bas de'ang ka dag gi rig pa ngos bzung*/ lhun grub kyi rang snang la yid ches na grol lo/ de dag gi tshe rjes dran drug

mngon shes drug 'char/ sngon thos dang ma thos pa'i chos rnams 'char/ da ni de dag tu ma grol na srid pa bar dor yur ba rkang chag pa la wa 'dzug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag ni 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug sogs 'char ba'i yid lus can du snang bas/ shar mngon dga'/ 691)lho dpal ldan/ nub bde chen/ byang las rab/ dbus dur khrod me ri 'bar ba rnams su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag tu gtad/ skye gnas ngan pa/ lha mi la 'od dkar po/ yi dwags la du ba 'dra ba/ dmyal ba la sdong dum lta bu'am bal nag gsed pa lta bu/ byol song la khrag mtsho lta bu/ lha min la kha char babs pa lta bu/ bde 'gror 'gro na mgo gyen/ ngan 'gro la thur/ lha min byol song la phred bstan pa ltar snang bas/ de dag la dga' sdug gi zhen pa ldog zhing dag par smon lam 'debs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ smon lam sogs dran pa gzhur nas gnas ngan du mi 'jug pa la gzab par bya'o/ de dag ni dran gsos gsal 'debs tsam ste rgyas par ye shes bla ma las shes par bya'o// padma ma ṇi zhes byas bris// 692)
